## PubMed strategy

The **one-line query** is saved verbatim in [final-query.txt](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-535fe3dc7ca88971/ours-codex-noseed-20260928T210148Z/work/final-query.txt). The complete line-by-line strategy, counts, and audit are in [audit.md](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-535fe3dc7ca88971/ours-codex-noseed-20260928T210148Z/work/audit.md).

The final search retrieved **9,534 records**, with the Entrez-date bound through **2017-05-06** and no publication-date limit.

| Search lines | Contents | Count |
|---|---|---:|
| 1–5 | MeSH headings for small vessel disease and related markers | Individual counts in the audit |
| 6–44 | Exposure text words and synonyms | — |
| 45 | Combined exposure block | 78,446 |
| 46–74 | Dementia and cognitive outcome MeSH/text words | — |
| 75 | Combined outcome block | 321,574 |
| 76 | Exposure AND outcome | **9,534** |

Requiring the optional outcome block reduced the exposure-only count by **87.8%**. A refreshed sample of 30 records removed by that block contained no eligible study. Community/population sampling and longitudinal follow-up remain screening criteria.

Two eligible pilot records were found and added as a development set. Both were retrieved: **2/2, or 100% relative recall on this non-independent development set**. This is not independent validation or sensitivity. The outcome category probe is stale after the final exposure-term addition; its two-probe budget was spent. The internal critic accepted this as a documented residual sampling risk. **Independent information-specialist PRESS peer review is still pending.**

The protected delivery passed validation: [validation-manifest.json](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-535fe3dc7ca88971/ours-codex-noseed-20260928T210148Z/work/validation-manifest.json).
